posts.title: The Great Turkey Heist
posts.description: The Boxcar Children help to set up a food bank around Thanksgiving, but someone is trying to sabotage it! Children's mystery book.

posts.title: Sarah and Katie
posts.description: Sarah and her best friend, Katie, have been writing a play together that their class will perform for their Thanksgiving celebration. When Sarah wants to give the new girl in class the starring role, it leads to conflict in their friendship and insight into the difference between appearance and substance. Children's book.

posts.title: Stage Fright
posts.description: Sara is incredibly shy, and she's worried about being in her class's play at school. Children's book.
